modules.name: Card demo core
modules.what_it_does: Runs the credit-card back office: the CICS screens for sign-on, accounts, cards, transactions, bill pay, reporting and user administration, and the VSAM batch cycle that posts transactions, calculates interest and prints statements.
modules.reasoning: the repository's own top-level libraries (app/cbl, app/cpy, app/jcl, app/proc, app/bms), one CSD group CARDDEMO, and the scheduler exports that order its jobs
modules.scan: python3 -m mftb scan --module CARDDEMO --src app/cbl --copy app/cpy --copy app/cpy-bms --jcl app/jcl --proc app/proc --cntl app/ctl --sched app/scheduler --csd app/csd
